comment: 8yo male with biallelic ATM germline pathogenic variants confirmed in family, progressive cerebellar ataxia from age 3 + oculocutaneous telangiectasias + recurrent sinopulmonary infections (humoral + cellular immunodeficiency) + elevated serum AFP. No current malignancy. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = hematology-oncology surveillance (CBC + CT-sparing whole-body MRI cadence) + immunology co-management + radiation-hypersensitivity advisory + parental genetic counseling; alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation. Validates v0.2-B rare-hereditary pilot — fires RF-AT-FAMILY-HISTORY-SUSPICION. CRITICAL: radiation hypersensitivity precludes diagnostic CT + therapeutic RT when feasible.
